title: Miscellaneous Accommodations for Cognitive and Academic Deficits
description: Cross-cutting interventions for perceived cognitive and academic deficits, including reminders, scheduling supports, motivation hooks, and recognition-based test formats. Use when the student needs general executive-function scaffolding, memory aids, or interest-based engagement that doesn't fit a single context.

source.name: ADayInOurShoes — Ultimate List of IEP Accommodations, Modifications & Strategies (SDIs)
source.section: Miscellaneous, interventions for perceived cognitive and academic deficits

accommodations.text: Alarms as reminders — phone, wristwatch, etc.
AM/PM check-in with a preferred staff person.
Incorporate the child's personal interests into activities whenever possible.
When appropriate and not distracting, guide the student through real-life situations.
Test format that taps 'recognition memory' — such as matching or multiple choice — rather than fill-in-the-blank without a word bank.
